meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、调整隔离级别、修改接线关系，并检查遗留问题。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或重新组织消息频道（如 Telegram、Slack）与智能体组的对应关系时触发，例如添加新频道后、初始设置期间或单独运行重新配置。

say.text: 帮我查看当前所有频道和智能体组的接线情况。
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库并显示摘要。

say.text: 检查 WhatsApp 群组是否有遗留的‘回复一切’接线问题。
say.note: Claude 会运行一次性检查并报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the connection between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, adjust isolation levels, modify wiring, and check for legacy issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or reorganize the mapping of messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) to agent groups, such as after adding a new channel, during initial setup, or standalone reconfiguration.

say_en.text: Show me the current wiring of all channels and agent groups.
say_en.note: Claude will query the database and display a summary.

say_en.text: Wire the Telegram group 'support' to the 'customer-service' agent group with shared session mode.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the wiring operation.

say_en.text: Check for legacy 'reply-all' wiring issues on WhatsApp groups.
say_en.note: Claude will run a one-time check and report.
